title: Rebuild V1 after state-machine parity repair
reason: The frozen state-machine addendum forbids rearming the same candidate on a confirmation, invalidation or expiry clearing bar. The prior generator violated that rule, so its proposal registry and all downstream summaries are invalidated.
required_order: run the new synthetic state-machine tests
rerun the deterministic raw proposal generator on the authorized historical CSV root
persist the complete raw registry before deduplication or outcome handling
rebuild and hash-freeze the full label-free audit
freeze reproducible expanding purged walk-forward evaluation code and split manifest
only then join the pinned frozen ML-03 labels and recompute reporting layers
invalidated_outputs_must_not_be_used: previous ML threshold and score summary
local_action: Run the repaired audit branch against the historical source that exists only on the user PC; do not run the live runtime as part of this rebuild.
